notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

To celebrate Winter and Christmas we have launched a new Winter Update on Hidden in my Paradise today! ☃️ 🎄

❄️ New Winter zone
🏔️ 6 new levels
🎿 200+ new objects!
